units.source_text: 在舞蹈会开始之前，太吉郎就闷闷不乐地坐在茶席上。

en.t: Before the dance performance began, Takichiro was already sitting gloomily at the tea席.

units.source_text: 今天当班坐在那儿以茶道礼法泡制抹茶的艺伎，也没有太吉郎所熟悉的。

en.t: Among the geisha on duty today, seated there preparing matcha according to tea ceremony etiquette, there was no one Takichiro knew.
